title: Fel's conjecture proved and verified in Lean
summary: Axiom Prover generated a proof of Fel's conjecture on syzygies of numerical semigroups, verified in Lean 4 with Mathlib, without hints, lemmas, or manual corrections after the run began. This is a case study and an unreviewed preprint, with no data on attempts or time taken.

evidence.tested: The proof of Fel's conjecture was generated by AxiomProver with no hints, lemmas or manual corrections after kickoff and checked by Lean 4 with Mathlib; the formalization is publicly available and the mathematical results appear in a human-written arXiv preprint.
evidence.unknown: The authors state the limiting factor is often the quality of the shared library (Mathlib), and the post describes a single case study with no claim about automating research.
evidence.ai_role: AxiomProver translated the statement into Lean, generated intermediate lemmas and assembled the complete Lean proof.
